description: A PostHog data warehouse source: a connection to an external system (e.g. Postgres, Stripe, Hubspot) whose tables PostHog syncs into the data warehouse or queries live.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the source belongs to.

SourceType.description: The source type, e.g. Postgres, Stripe, Hubspot. Changing it replaces the source.

Payload.description: Connection credentials and settings as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). Keys depend on SourceType. Add a 'schemas' array to pick which tables sync; omit it and every discovered table syncs with default settings. Write-only: never read back. Changing it later sends the new values (without 'schemas') as the source's job inputs.

Prefix.description: Prefix added to the table names PostHog creates in HogQL. Does not filter which tables are imported.

AccessMethod.description: Connection mode: `warehouse` (import, the default) or `direct` (live query). Changing it replaces the source.

DirectQueryEnabled.description: Whether a synced source should also be live-queryable via direct connection. Ignored for pure direct-query sources.

DestinationIds.description: IDs of the destinations every table on this source writes to. Omit to write to the PostHog warehouse only. Set on create only and never read back.

AutoSyncNewSchemas.description: Automatically enable syncing for schemas discovered on this source after creation. Not supported for direct-query sources.

AutoSyncSchemaPatterns.description: fnmatch-style globs (`*` and `?`), e.g. `raw_*`, restricting which newly discovered schema names auto-sync. Empty means every new schema qualifies. Only used when AutoSyncNewSchemas is true.

Status.description: Sync status of the source, e.g. Running, Completed, Error.

LastRunAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last sync run.
